kebab_example: aliyun aiworkspace validate-connection --configs key=example-string --connection-id conn-x2wz5zvvbyf2420fi9 --connection-type DashScopeConnection --secrets key=example-string --validate-type Connectivity --workspace-id 1234 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ValidateConnection

parameters.help_en: The configuration of the connection, specified as key-value pairs. The configuration keys vary by connection type. For more information, see the supplementary information about the request parameters of the CreateConnection operation
parameters.help_zh: 连接的配置信息。以key-value的形式配置，不同的连接类型对应的Config配置的key不相同。具体参见CreateConnection接口的请求参数补充说明
parameters.name: configs

parameters.help_en: The connection ID. For more information about how to obtain the connection ID, see [ListConnections](url)
parameters.help_zh: 连接ID。如何获取连接 ID，详情请参见 [ListConnections](url)
parameters.name: connection_id

parameters.help_en:
The connection type. Only connection types that support public network access are available. Valid values:

DashScopeConnection: a service connection for Alibaba Cloud Model Studio.

DeepSeekConnection: a service connection for DeepSeek.

FunctionAIMCPConnection: a connection for Function AI MCP.

CustomMCPConnection: a custom MCP connection
parameters.help_zh:
连接的类型，当前支持填写可公网访问的连接类型：
DashScopeConnection：百炼服务连接。
DeepSeekConnection：DeepSeek服务连接。
FunctionAIMCPConnection：Function AI MCP连接。
CustomMCPConnection：自定义MCP连接
parameters.name: connection_type

parameters.help_en: The key-value pairs to encrypt, such as a database logon password or a model connection key
parameters.help_zh: 需要加密的key-value配置。如数据库登录密码，模型连接的key等
parameters.name: secrets

parameters.help_en:
The validation type. Set the value to:

Connectivity: a connectivity test
parameters.help_zh:
验证类型。可设置为：
Connectivity：连通性测试
parameters.name: validate_type

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. For more information about how to obtain the workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.name: workspace_id
